measurement_variance_rule.scope: Each of the eight non-target controls independently, separately for direct and normalized metrics. Inspect both same-product null pairs B2/B3 and A6/A7.
measurement_variance_rule.direct_null_ratio: Earlier CPP median / later CPP median for each same-product pair.
measurement_variance_rule.normalized_null_ratio: Later original/CPP ratio / earlier original/CPP ratio for each same-product pair.
measurement_variance_rule.if_either_null_ratio_outside_interval: Require worst observed A/B gain >=0.97 for THAT control and THAT metric. Otherwise UNRESOLVED_MEASUREMENT. No blanket null-band veto or relaxed floors.
measurement_variance_rule.worst_direct: min(all four A CPP pass medians) / max(all four B CPP pass medians)
measurement_variance_rule.worst_normalized: min(all four B original/CPP ratios) / max(all four A original/CPP ratios)
measurement_variance_rule.always_publish: All direct/reference/normalized null ratios, all A/B pass values and both worst-pair gains for every control.
measurement_variance_rule.invariants: All fixed balanced3% floors, RGB-first per-pass floors, target/global/original gates remain required. Large separated gains may pass despite observed null variance; do not label that measurement stable.
